speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether all HDB rental flats are installed with fire-rated doors in light of the latest fire incident in Boon Lay.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: All HDB blocks also incorporate other fire safety features.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: For instance, common corridors and lift lobbies are designed to be naturally ventilated for quick smoke dispersal.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Equipment like fire hose reels, rising mains and firefighting lobbies are also provided, where required by the Fire Code, to facilitate firefighting.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This will help to alert residents to fires early and enable them to put out the fire or evacuate to safety.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
text: Recently, in Boon Lay, there was a fire at one of the HDB rental flats which generates this question.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: I do not think SCDF's requirements are just the bare minimum.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But as I raised yesterday, we have seen recent fires of units that face external corridors, it did affect the neighbouring unit.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The smoke did not just dissipate upwards and it was well-ventilated.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, I support Mr Patrick Tay's call to have fire-rated doors for all units.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, can we at least offer it as an option during the Home Improvement Programme (HIP)?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Because I think when we go to the HIP showroom, they only offer non fire-rated doors there.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, if we cannot supply, then can we at least provide it as an option for residents to choose to pay for the fire-rated doors if they want?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: They are the specialists in this area, not HDB.
